purpose: Coordinated section-title illustrations grounded in the assigned textbook; symbolic study visuals, not scientific figures.

assets.conversion: Lossless WebP; original RGBA PNG retained; no visual post-processing.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent illustration for the title slide 'Formal and informal shortcuts'.
Primary request: illustrate how study prompts turn the same textbook chapter into different study activities.
Subject: one open ivory-paper textbook with a dark-petrol cover. Five small study cards fan gently upward from its pages: a pair of flashcards, a quiz with checkboxes, a simple branching concept map, a short summary represented by neat ink strokes, and a conversation bubble with a slash-shaped mark. These are symbolic study materials, without readable text. A small orange bookmark ties the group together. The book stays the main object; the study cards feel like paper extensions of the chapter, not computer windows. Use a coherent three-quarter view slightly from above.
Style/medium: high-end editorial 3D paper sculpture, tactile ivory paper and matte dark-petrol book covers, carefully folded layers, soft realistic shading, clean refined silhouettes. Coordinate this as a pair for a university workshop presentation about studying the same generative-AI textbook. Palette: ivory, deep petrol/charcoal, saturated teal with small warm-orange accents, matching a dark charcoal slide with white typography. Composition: portrait 4:5, a single compact centered sculptural group, all objects fully visible, generous clear space around the silhouette, suitable for the right half of a title slide. Lighting: soft directional studio light, readable against dark charcoal. Background: genuinely transparent alpha; no room, no ground plane, no background rectangle or vignette. Text: none. Constraints: no letters, no words, no numerals, no logos, no watermark, no people or robots; no glowing AI brain, no neon. Do not draw a complete slide or a title.

assets.editPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied transparent Skills illustration.

Leave at least 6 percent truly transparent clearance around every outer edge of the complete group. Preserve the 4:5 portrait aspect ratio. Preserve all objects, their arrangement, the exact dark-petrol/ivory/teal/orange palette, tactile paper materials, lighting, three instruction cards, resource folder, and pictograms.
